response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT counts.constructorId, counts.nationality, counts.record_count, counts.record_count - average_count.avg_count AS difference_from_average FROM counts CROSS JOIN average_count WHERE counts.record_count > average_count.avg_count ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC, counts.constructorId LIMIT 10
